note: Where every NASA picture in data/nasa/ comes from, and the live NASA service the page can ask for finer pictures. The About & sources dialog of the page is built from this file. Entries in files with fetch=true can be downloaded again with scripts/fetch_nasa_data.py. NASA does not endorse this project.

files.role: The map picture that opens with the page (also copied inside index.html as base64). Values are read from it.
files.note: Equirectangular, 1024 x 512, no date stamp. It was the most recent frame when downloaded; its date was found by comparing it with the EXR frames of 9, 10 and 11 November 2026.
files.dataset: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Anomaly - Near Real Time
files.underlying_data: JPL MUR SST analysis (Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution Sea Surface Temperature), PO.DAAC; SVS dataset ID 845

files.role: NASA's colour bar (-4 to +4 degrees C). The colour table in index.html was read from it.
files.note: A colour scale, not a map of one day.
files.dataset: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Anomaly - Near Real Time
files.underlying_data: JPL MUR SST analysis (Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution Sea Surface Temperature), PO.DAAC; SVS dataset ID 845

files.role: One picture of the time slider.
files.processing: NASA publishes this frame only as a 4096 x 2048 EXR file (the url). It was reduced to 1024 x 512 (average of 4 x 4 pixels), converted to 8-bit colour with the sRGB curve and saved as a JPEG (quality 90). The url is the original, not this file.

live_sources.name: Sea Surface Temperature Anomalies (L4, MUR, GHRSST)
live_sources.service: NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), WMS
live_sources.acknowledgement: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
live_sources.underlying_data: JPL MUR SST analysis (Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution Sea Surface Temperature), PO.DAAC
live_sources.dates_available: 2019-07-23 to the latest day (one picture a day, with a few gaps)
live_sources.how_used: Requested by the page while it is used, for the area on screen. Nothing from it is stored in this project. Colour classes of 0.1 degrees C from -3 to +3, read with the colour table above (copied from the colormap url). The Live detail button switches it off.

live_sources.name: Blue Marble Shaded Relief and Bathymetry (MODIS)
live_sources.service: NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), WMTS tiles (EPSG:4326, tile matrix set 500m)
live_sources.acknowledgement: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
live_sources.underlying_data: Blue Marble Shaded Relief and Bathymetry (MODIS), as described in the GIBS layer list
live_sources.how_used: Requested by the page as map tiles (levels 0 to 7, about 300 m per pixel at the finest) and shown under the temperature picture, so land shows detail when you zoom in. Nothing from it is stored in this project, and no value, sound or text is read from it. If the tiles cannot be loaded, the page shows the saved picture alone.
